en_title: Halo: Campaign Evolved to Get Firefight as a Free Update
cn_title: 《光环：战役进化》将通过免费更新加入持久战模式
opus_summary: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma宣布，《光环：战役进化》将在今冬通过免费更新加入持久战模式。这将是该重制版推出的首个多人模式。游戏于7月发售时未包含多人模式，此次更新也可能预示未来会加入更多多人模式。

paragraphs.en: When Halo: Campaign Evolved first came out in July it did not include any multiplayer modes, but the first-person shooter remake will at least get Firefight as a free update this winter.
paragraphs.cn: 《光环：战役进化》于7月首次发售时没有包含任何多人游戏模式，但这款第一人称射击重制游戏至少将在今年冬天通过免费更新加入持久战模式。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced the returning mode in a social media post Thursday, along with a graphic showing a team of Spartans shooting a mix of Covenant and Flood enemies with various guns.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma周四在一篇社交媒体帖子中宣布了这一回归模式，并配发了一张图片，画面中一队斯巴达战士正用各式枪械向星盟和虫族敌人射击。

paragraphs.en: While Firefight isn't the arena competitive multiplayer that most fans had hoped from the Halo remake at launch, wave-based PvE has been a mainstay in the series since Halo 3: ODST in 2009. Essentially, you and your friends load into a map and fight increasingly difficult waves of enemies until you get overwhelmed. There's no reason to believe that this iteration is going to be any different.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然持久战模式并非大多数粉丝希望《光环》重制版在发售时提供的竞技场多人对战模式，但自2009年的《光环3：ODST》以来，以波次为基础的PvE一直是该系列的主要内容。基本上，你和朋友进入一张地图，对抗一波波难度越来越高的敌人，直到寡不敌众。没有理由认为这次的版本会有什么不同。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of whether or not Team Deathmatch comes to Halo: Campaign Evolved, this will be the first multiplayer mode to hit the remake, which was pitched primarily as a straight-up revival of the iconic Combat Evolved campaign. Multiplayer was the major piece missing from Campaign Evolved, and this could be a sign that more multiplayer modes will be added in the future.
paragraphs.cn: 无论团队死斗模式是否会加入《光环：战役进化》，持久战都将是这款重制版推出的首个多人游戏模式。这款游戏主要被定位为对标志性的《光环：战斗进化》战役的直接重现。多人游戏是《光环：战役进化》缺失的重要部分，而这可能预示着未来会加入更多多人游戏模式。

paragraphs.en: IGN's Halo: Combat Evolved remake gave it a 7 . We said: "Halo: Campaign Evolved speaks to the series' timelessness and adds a decent set of new missions, but it's a mostly a lean retread that's more of a test run for its future with Unreal Engine."
paragraphs.cn: IGN为《光环：战斗进化》重制版打出了7分。我们写道：「《光环：战役进化》体现了该系列历久弥新的魅力，并加入了一组不错的新任务，但它大体上只是一次精简的重制，更像是在为系列使用Unreal Engine的未来进行试水。」

paragraphs.en: This Firefight announcement comes as Xbox celebrates its 25th anniversary. Earlier today, Sharma looked ahead, predicting "a single person will soon be able to wield capabilities that once required entire nations."
paragraphs.cn: 持久战模式的消息公布之际，XBOX正在庆祝其25周年。今天早些时候，Sharma展望未来，预测「一个人很快就能运用过去需要举国之力才能拥有的能力」。

paragraphs.en: As for Halo, following the summer's drastic cuts at Microsoft's gaming business, Xbox announced a significant reshuffle that saw the next mainline Halo game handed to Call of Duty developer Activision , which is spinning up a new team to work on the franchise. Mass layoffs hit Halo Studios at the same time.
paragraphs.cn: 至于《光环》，在微软游戏业务今夏遭到大规模削减后，XBOX宣布了一项重大调整，将下一款《光环》主线游戏交给了《使命召唤》开发商动视，后者正在组建一支新团队来负责该系列。与此同时，光环Studios遭遇了大规模裁员。
